scope: Independent skeptical review of all 10 screen, 5 defense, and 3 comparison pages. Text extracted in full and all pages rendered and visually inspected. Root models and PDFs not edited.
overall: The artifacts honestly distinguish facts from forecasts and improve the research. They do not finalize a competition recommendation. Under the latest task scope, that is a disclosed remaining investment decision, not a reason to invent LONG or SHORT. The immediate correctable defects are missing business overview, underexposed manufacturing/packaging assumptions, stale workload status, and an incomplete explanation of favorable-case value at the current price.

findings.finding: A real DCAI recovery is established, but the screen does not expose the manufacturing recovery required by its own group forecast. Foundry EBIT contributes 32.56% of the 2027-to-2030 EBIT improvement; gross new packaging sales rise 14-fold. Neither is made visible in the screen.
findings.evidence: Selected Foundry EBIT -4.0B to +2.5B; total EBIT 13.079B to33.042B. Packaging sales 0.5B to7.0B. Q3 filing MD&A p35 attributes YTD Foundry loss improvement to lower period charges, partly offset by 0.936B lower product profit.
findings.fix: Show 2027/2030 DCAI, CCPG, Foundry, packaging, corporate and consolidated EBIT; label each assumption. Add independently motivated later/flat manufacturing-cost controls without double charging the 50% group sales decremental. Expose packaging customer/revenue/capital hurdles.

findings.finding: Selecting the favorable operating case alone still does not establish an attractive entry under the existing valuation policy.
findings.evidence: The 73.5608 December2030 favorable target corresponds to48.5577 December2026 planning value versus52.25 quoted entry. This bridge is omitted while the notes say a favorable-case modest LONG could be valid.
findings.fix: Include favorable present planning value alongside its future target. State that an affirmative LONG additionally needs a defended required-return/risk judgment; do not imply a positive future return proves undervaluation. Keep the56-day date mismatch visible. An8% selected horizon hurdle needs71.93;10% needs77.63;12% needs83.66. These are user/investor hurdle arithmetic, not competition rules.

findings.finding: The ten-page screen has no direct company overview explaining the business and sources of revenue/profit; acronyms and accounting rows substitute for it.
findings.evidence: M37 explicitly requires a brief company overview in Round1. Current p2 starts with Xeon adoption; p3 starts with consolidation and unexplained CCPG/DCAI.
findings.fix: Add a compact overview with PC/client and server products, integrated manufacturing, nascent external foundry/packaging, and All Other. Explain internal Foundry revenues eliminate and that chip sales must cover factory cost, R&D and capital investment. This helps research readers even before a recommendation is chosen.

findings.finding: Repeated statements that forecasts are not disproven or not uniquely supported are true but do not themselves evaluate which underwriting case to choose. Feasible is different from probable; uncertainty is not automatically bearish.
findings.fix: For each material driver, present the affirmative supporting evidence, contrary observation, selected assumption, reason for selection, sensitivity and falsifier. Keep the remaining recommendation explicitly unresolved if evidence/judgment cannot support either direction; do not solve the form by target-fitting. Future certainty is not required by M37.

findings.finding: The PDFs still describe matched successful workload evidence as future research despite the completed bounded RunsOn analysis.
findings.evidence: workload/matched_workload_proof_audit.json completed07:22UTC: ten original logs/five pairs; same configured Rust build passes45tests every run; AMD median87svIntel114s; AMD normalized EC2+EBS cost11.16%lower. Advertised resources match but physical core mappings differ; actual invoices and full TCO remain absent.
findings.fix: Replace a generic future-task paragraph with the bounded current competitor result and its limits. Say reproduced public raw records, not our experiment. Do not apply a direct Intel margin/ASP haircut from cloud-price differences.

findings.finding: The main artifact repeatedly asks readers to compare with an old forecast they have never seen. This makes a ten-page screen about research revisions rather than a standalone investment analysis.
findings.fix: Use actual/2026E/2027/2030 columns, selected/favorable operating regimes and their source rationales. Preserve chronology and old-model explanations in supporting notes; no need to remove the archive or conceal the change.

findings.finding: The 0.8% comparison is carefully labeled but cannot establish either a price edge or its absence: it is one company-sales year, not CPU/margin/cash consensus or a price-implied forecast.
findings.fix: Keep same-date/same-scope qualification. State exactly what variable is disputed and avoid treating near-consensus2027total sales as proof that no differentiated long-term thesis exists. If no matching source is available, state the missing comparison rather than manufacture consensus.

findings.finding: The11.555%rate,0.8capital turnover and long-run growth remain major policy inputs; numerical precision and reconciliation do not validate their economic levels.
findings.fix: Briefly explain their economic rationale and show a small decision-relevant bracket. Describe identities as reconciled, current facts as sourced, future assumptions as selected. Avoid expanding formulas that do not change the claim.

supported_claims: Screen p.2 DCAI operating income of $7.055B on $18.632B revenue matches the Q3 2026 10-Q. Intel attributes most YTD DCAI profit improvement to higher product profit; it is not just the absence of Gaudi charges.
AWS names Orion, SAP and Workday and describes customer performance/licensing benefits. The PDF correctly treats these as vendor-hosted testimonials, not independent tests or Intel procurement data.
Selected $53.43 target, 0.5% annual appreciation, $35.40 planning value and 93.2% after-2030 operating-value concentration match the integrated results.

The comparison correctly identifies WMS 2024 and JBI 2023 first-place equity awards in the UNC archive and Waterloo as 2024 global CFA champion. It avoids invented winning odds and acknowledges differing rules.
All 18 pages rendered without apparent text overlap, clipping or broken tables. Source hyperlinks are present; footer text is small but readable at full page.
what_can_be_closed_now: Reconcile and independently reproduce arithmetic, dates, claims and scope.
Verify historical segment profitability and precisely attribute reported improvement.
Reproduce the limited matched successful-work benchmark and cost estimate.
Expose the operating assumptions that drive the price; calculate required outcomes and downside sensitivity.
Repair the missing company overview, stale evidence status and internal research-history narrative.
what_cannot_be_proved_now: Future 2030 or 2040 cash flows, realized returns or competition outcome.
Physical accepted Intel package quantities, net procurement pricing or post-renewal retention from the current public record.
A complete cloud bill from estimated EC2/EBS fields.
A unique probability distribution over the scenarios from these model outputs.

rules.requirements: Individual STEM student; Intel or SpaceX; LONG or SHORT; 3-5 years; no more than 10-page PDF; company overview, drivers, risks; name, class year, resume; November 9, 2026; no exact deadline hour published.
rules.scope_warning: A completed research review can answer the latest task; it must not be described as a finalized or compliant competition recommendation while LONG/SHORT remains unresolved.
